register: The sources an application may ask the frame to fetch
note: QGD-APP-0008. An application names a source; the URL is here. It never names a destination and never opens a connection — the fetch is the Rust credential core's, because all of this product's outbound HTTPS goes through it (D-18, D-31). A grant is source:<id>, so adding a source means adding its grant to data/extension-grants.json as well, and an application asking for a source with no grant is refused before the URL is looked up.
